- Initial release of JD Lawsuit skill.

JD Lawsuit Skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides a CLI interface for managing JD internal lawsuit/arbitration cases via JoyDesk.
- Supports case list querying with filters (status, type, search, paging) and multiple output formats.
- Enables merchant detail screenshot automation, including plaintext information extraction.
- Integrates with Electron-based authentication and Playwright browser automation.
- Includes sample workflows, API/schema references, and operational details for robust usage.
